title: 第八章   夜黑风高，魔兽袭来
content_zh:
夜色弥漫着大地，冷冽的夜风吹拂着，树上的叶子唰唰的响着，使得原本就阴森的死亡森林变得越发地恐怖，守夜的佣兵双目不停着扫视着树林之中一切阴暗的角落，似有不把一切阴暗之地清除就不罢休的决心。

    夜不知为何过得如此缓慢，火堆周围的雇佣兵相互聊天着，打趣着，想把心中的不闷压在心底，不让其影响自身的情绪。

    嗖！树林的漆黑之处突然传出了一声。“谁，出来，别再那里装神弄鬼！再不出来，可别怪我不客气了！”说话的正是雇佣兵的团长杜狼。此刻的他脸庞在火堆的映衬下变得异常狰狞。

    “吼！”一只魔兽从树林中蹿了出来，对着火堆旁的人便是一声怒吼，从魔兽的愤怒中可以看出很这里很显然就是它的领地，此刻的它正试图捍卫自己的领地，想把侵入它领地的人灭杀，因为雇佣兵人数众多，它没有把握赢得战斗，所以等到天黑才动手。

    “大家准备攻击，这是一头三阶魔兽，紫金苍狼，”杜狼立即对着雇佣兵喊到。

    “三阶紫金苍狼！好家伙，自身实力相当于人类**境强者，这可真是个好地方！”琼霄心道。随即也随着雇佣兵行动起来。

    “大伙小心应对，这头畜生相当于我们人类**境的强者，围住它，杀了这畜生，取了其灵核可以卖个不错的价钱！”此时的杜狼还不忘鼓动着涌动的佣兵。

    再怎么说雇佣兵里的人几乎都是化星境以上的实力，团长更是化星境巅峰，难道还对付不了一直**境中期的紫禁苍狼不成？这头紫禁苍狼显然是打错了算盘。“智商就是硬伤啊！”琼霄望着这暴怒的紫禁苍狼无奈的摇了摇头，“既然你要找死，那只能送你去上路了！”琼霄跟着人群围了上去。

    “找死的畜生，看我的！裂地掌！”杜狼一掌朝着苍狼脑袋打了过去，一掌带着劲风打在了苍狼头上。顿时苍狼头上鲜血直流。

    “吼！”此时苍狼更加的暴怒，“碰！”的一声，从苍狼口中迸发的能量球击中了杜狼胸口！一击之下杜狼飞出几十丈之远。噗嗤！鲜血从落地之后杜狼口中喷出，“快动手，还愣着干嘛！”杜狼怒吼道。

    “看我的！”问声而动的佣兵开始对苍狼展开了猛烈攻击，“碰！”又有一人飞出战场，“孽畜，好强，看我的！”一个壮汉又是一拳打在了苍狼先前遭受攻击的头上，这人正是招募佣兵的大汉——韩生，无一例外韩生也与先前的佣兵一样被攻击而倒地不起。“大家集中力量攻击！”杜狼话语一落，旋即数十道能量犹如陨石，尽数落在了紫禁苍狼身上，刹那间，苍狼的气息立刻变得萎靡起来。

    如今的苍狼已遭受重创，但周围的佣兵没有立刻冲上去，此刻的杜狼身受重伤，周围的佣兵多多少少也受了一些伤。没有杜狼的领头，佣兵们也不敢轻易的冲上去，谁也不敢轻易的拿性命去赌博，就这样人与魔兽对峙着，时间一分一秒的过去……

    “不能在这样下去了！这是我来主导攻击，大家看我的攻击而动手！”琼霄突然开口打破了死一般的寂静。

    “动手！冲！”琼霄立即冲了出去，艰难躲过了迎面而来的能量球，琼霄一跃而起一剑砸在了苍狼原本就饱受攻击的头上，这也怪不得琼霄，重剑无锋，只能当棍棒使用，霎时苍狼头上血花飞溅，“吼！”巨大的悲鸣声顺势而起，面对突如其来的巨爪拍下，琼霄举起重剑挡住了胸口，“碰！”琼霄旋即被拍了下来，连续后退了好几十步。

    “好硬的重剑！要不是这把重剑，估计我又是重伤的结果！要不是背了几天的重剑，估计连拿起剑都很费劲，更不用说拿着重剑抵御住了苍狼的攻击。”琼霄心里暗自悻悻。

    “好机会，大伙上！”面对着再遭受重创的苍狼，佣兵们一拥而上，面对如此密集的攻击，只有**境中期的紫金苍狼来说，只能是落得引恨而终的下场。

    “轰！”的一声，庞大的身躯倒在了地上，地上的苍狼眼里充满了不甘。渐渐的紫金苍狼眼里的生机迅速消失，最终死亡。
content_en:
Night filled the earth, the cold night wind blew, and the leaves on the trees rustled, making the originally gloomy forest of death more and more terrifying. The eyes of the vigilant mercenaries kept scanning all the dark corners in the forest, as if they were determined not to stop until all dark places were cleared away.

    I don't know why the night passed so slowly. The mercenaries around the fire were chatting and joking with each other, trying to suppress the boredom in their hearts and not let it affect their emotions.

    Whoosh! A sudden sound came from the darkness of the woods. "Who, come out and stop pretending! If you don't come out, don't blame me for being rude!" It was Du Lang, the leader of the mercenaries, who spoke. At this moment, his face became extremely ferocious against the fire.

    "Roar!" A monster jumped out of the woods and roared at the people beside the fire. It could be seen from the anger of the monster that this was its territory. At this moment, it was trying to defend its territory and wanted to kill the people who invaded its territory. Because of the large number of mercenaries, it was not sure of winning the battle, so it waited until dark before taking action.

    "Everyone, prepare to attack. This is a third-level monster, the Purple Gold Wolf," Du Lang immediately shouted to the mercenaries.

    "Third-level Purple Gold Wolf! What a good guy, his own strength is equivalent to that of a strong human being in the upper realm. This is really a good place!" Qiong Xiao thought to himself. Immediately, the mercenaries also took action.

    "Everyone, be careful. This beast is equivalent to a strong man in our human realm. Surround it, kill it, and take its spiritual core and sell it for a good price!" At this time, Du Lang did not forget to encourage the mercenaries.

    After all, almost all of the mercenaries are above the Star Transformation Realm, and the leader is at the top of the Star Transformation Realm. Could it be that he still can't deal with the Forbidden Wolf who is still in the middle of the Xingxing Realm? This Forbidden Wolf obviously made the wrong calculation. "IQ is a flaw!" Qiong Xiao looked at the furious Forbidden Wolf and shook his head helplessly, "Since you are looking for death, I can only send you on your way!" Qiong Xiao followed the crowd and surrounded him.

    "You beast looking for death, look at me! Earth-shattering palm!" Du Lang hit the wolf on the head with a palm, and the palm hit the wolf's head with strong wind. Immediately blood flowed from Canglang's head.

    "Roar!" At this time, Cang Lang became even more furious. With a "touch!", the energy ball bursting out from Cang Lang's mouth hit Du Lang's chest! With one blow, Du Lang flew dozens of feet away. Poof! Blood spurted out from Du Lang's mouth after he landed on the ground, "Do it quickly, why are you still standing there!" Du Lang roared angrily.

    "Look at me!" The mercenary who asked asked began to violently attack the wolf. "Bump!" Another person flew out of the battlefield. "You evil beast, you are so strong. Look at me!" A strong man punched the head of the wolf that had been attacked before. This man was the big man who recruited the mercenaries - Han Sheng. Without exception, Han Sheng was attacked like the previous mercenaries and fell to the ground. "Everyone concentrate on attacking!" As soon as Du Lang finished speaking, dozens of energy rays were like meteorites, all falling on the Forbidden Wolf. In an instant, the Wolf's aura immediately became sluggish.

    Now Cang Lang has suffered heavy losses, but the surrounding mercenaries did not rush forward immediately. At this moment, Du Lang was seriously injured, and the surrounding mercenaries were also more or less injured. Without Du Lang as the leader, the mercenaries did not dare to rush forward easily, and no one dared to gamble with their lives. In this way, humans and monsters faced off, and time passed by...

    "We can't go on like this! This is me leading the attack, everyone is watching my attack and taking action!" Qiong Xiao suddenly spoke to break the deathly silence.

    "Do it! Charge!" Qiong Xiao immediately rushed out, struggling to avoid the oncoming energy ball. Qiong Xiao jumped up and hit the wolf's head with a sword that was already under attack. It's no wonder Qiong Xiao, the heavy sword has no edge and can only be used as a club. , blood spattered on the wolf's head, "Roar!" A huge scream followed the situation. Facing the sudden giant claw, Qiong Xiao raised his heavy sword to block his chest, "touch!" Qiong Xiao was immediately slapped down and took dozens of steps back.

    "What a hard epee! If it hadn't been for this epee, I would have been seriously injured again! If it hadn't been for carrying the epee for several days, it would have been very difficult to even pick up the sword, let alone resist the wolf's attack with the epee." Qiong Xiao was secretly resentful in her heart.

    "Good opportunity, everyone, come on!" Facing the Canglang who suffered another heavy blow, the mercenaries swarmed forward. Faced with such a dense attack, only the Zijin Canglang who was in the middle stage of the Golden Realm could only end up being hated.

    With a sound of "Boom!", the huge body fell to the ground, and the eyes of the wolf on the ground were full of unwillingness. Gradually, the vitality in Zijin Canglang's eyes quickly disappeared, and he eventually died.
title_en: Chapter 8 The night is dark and windy, and monsters are attacking
